title: Passive Voice: Verbs with Two Objects — Quiz 107A
content:
## Passive Voice: Verbs with Two Objects

Compare two passive constructions with a direct and an indirect object.

### Lesson focus

1. He gave me a story book.
2. I was given a story book.
3. A story book was given to me.
4. Dev teaches us English.
5. He bought his mother some flowers.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
